This plot is only 0.23 hectares and I do not own it, so I will not spend money on chemical fertilizer for these beans when manure from our livestock costs nothing and the beans themselves help fix nitrogen in the soil. I will plant the bean seeds I saved from last season because improved seed is too expensive for a rented piece of land, and my family will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting with hand hoes since the area is small. We do not spray pesticides on food crops like beans, and we depend entirely on the rains because we have no way to irrigate.
